metrics.catalogNotes: Items rely on sp-accordion querying its light-DOM sp-accordion-item children; the open state is reflected from the attribute.
Default variant is in normal flow (no overlay). Buttons use slot="buttons"; the internal close button is part of the shadow DOM.
Icon-only buttons rely on ObserveSlotPresence/ObserveSlotText (light-DOM queries) to decide label vs icon-only layout.
The group reads and writes selection state on its light-DOM sp-action-button children (querySelectorAll + slotchange), including the JSON selected attribute.
Rendered closed: only the trigger button is visible; the sp-menu-item children stay slotted inside the (closed) popover.
Banners are inline (not overlays) so they are shown with open. Dismissible banners render an internal close button.
Shown as static dialog content (the panel only); there is no sp-overlay/sp-underlay involved so nothing opens on load.
Images are inline data: URIs so the page needs no network access.
Images are inline data: URIs. The linked avatar renders as an anchor inside its shadow DOM.
Icon-only badge relies on the slot-presence observer to drop the label gap.

SSR difference: the overflow menu (sp-action-menu) starts keyboard focus on the selected item, client-side rendering on the first one (as for sp-picker). Without layout the server shows max-visible-items items. Overflow handling queries the sp-breadcrumb-item children and renders an sp-action-menu in the shadow root (closed).

metrics.catalogNotes: Covers sp-button, sp-clear-button and sp-close-button (the clear-button/close-button packages are CSS-only and contain no custom elements). The pending state renders an internal sp-progress-circle.
Pure layout container around light-DOM sp-button children.
Slots (cover-photo/preview/description/footer/actions) are detected through light-DOM presence queries. Images are inline data: URIs.
Label text is the default slot; invalid group exposes the negative-help-text slot.
sp-coachmark is rendered closed (display:none); only the sp-coach-indicator rings are visible. Coachmark extends sp-popover and uses overlay behaviour when opened.
The handle position is computed from color/hue/x/y properties; sp-color-handle is rendered inside the shadow root.
Extends sp-textfield; view-color renders a swatch whose color is derived from the parsed value.
Handle offset is derived from the value property; vertical orientation is purely an attribute.
Wheel geometry is CSS only, but the handle position is computed in JS from value; no layout measurement is required.
Options are light-DOM sp-menu-item elements that the combobox collects into its own (closed) listbox; autocomplete behaviour is driven by the value property.
The popover content stays slotted inside a closed internal sp-overlay; only the trigger is rendered visibly.
sp-dialog is shown as a static panel (it is only the dialog content, no overlay). sp-dialog-wrapper is rendered closed, so its sp-underlay/sp-dialog-base stay hidden.
Stateless; role="separator" and aria-orientation are applied in firstUpdated.
Idle state only (dragged and filled are false); the drag handlers are attached in the browser.
Help text slots (help-text / negative-help-text) are switched on the invalid attribute; the group itself has no JS-driven state.
The for attribute resolves against sibling ids in the same tree at connect time.
Negative help text uses an sp-icon-alert from icons-workflow, which sp-help-text imports itself.
Name-based icons (name="ui:Arrow100") need an sp-icons-* iconset and runtime fetching, so slotted SVGs and sp-icon-* workflow elements are used instead.
Heading/description are rendered either from attributes or from named light-DOM slots.
The anchor is rendered inside the shadow root and carries the href/target/download attributes.
The menu manages selection by querying its light-DOM items (incl. items nested in sp-menu-group); the selected state of each item must match the menu value.
Label text is the default slot (observed for presence); the fill width comes from the progress attribute.
The formatted display value is produced with Intl.NumberFormat from format-options; stepper buttons are part of the shadow DOM.
Every sp-overlay is closed (no open attribute). The overlay applies top-layer/popover APIs only when opened, so on the server only the slotted content and the trigger buttons are present.
Nothing is open on load. overlay-trigger has no sp- prefix: the trigger gets aria-expanded / aria-haspopup / aria-controls (and the click content a generated id) from the server-side slotchange.

SSR difference: the closed menu starts keyboard focus (tabindex="0") on the selected item after SSR + hydration, on the first item with client-side rendering (there the items are selected only after sp-menu cached them). Closed pickers: the button label is taken from the selected sp-menu-item (found by value in the light DOM and, for sp-picker, via @query(sp-menu) in its own shadow root). The popover stays closed. The deprecated sp-menu child (#picker-legacy) makes the picker render its closed overlay at once: sp-popover on the server and on desktops, sp-tray on phones (tests/mobile.spec.ts).

metrics.catalogNotes: No popover is open on load. The open attribute and the overlay positioning (floating-ui) are skipped entirely.
Fill width and aria-valuenow come from the progress attribute; no timers are involved.
The ring is drawn with CSS rotation derived from the progress attribute; the indeterminate animation is CSS only.
The group derives each radio checked state from its selected value by querying light-DOM sp-radio children (and vice versa for radios marked checked).
Renders a form with a textfield; the clear button visibility depends on the value being non-empty at render time.
Selection and expansion are computed from the value attribute and the nested sp-sidenav-item tree (ancestor queries); nested items live in the default slot of their parent item.

Handle position is derived from value/min/max; the multi-handle slider collects its sp-slider-handle children from the light DOM (slot="handle"). Editable sliders render an sp-number-field in the shadow root.

Pane sizes are computed from primary-size and the host size (offsetWidth/offsetHeight and getBoundingClientRect), which the server cannot measure; expect the splitter position to settle after hydration, especially for percentage sizes.
Stateless; aria-disabled is applied in updated() when disabled.

SSR difference: the selected swatch arrives with its final tabindex="0", so its first client update also sets the focusable attribute (client-side rendering sets it on the first swatch only). The group maps its selected JSON array onto child swatches by value (light-DOM querySelectorAll); the swatch fill is an inline CSS custom property computed from color.

metrics.catalogNotes: The selection indicator geometry and tab-panel visibility depend on the selected tab; sp-tabs reads its sp-tab children (light DOM) and measures offsets which the server cannot. sp-tabs-overflow measures clientWidth through a ResizeController to decide whether its scroll buttons are shown.
Avatar and icon slots are detected through light-DOM presence queries; images are inline data: URIs.

Native input/textarea live in the shadow root; validity (pattern) is evaluated at render time so the correct help-text slot is shown. Growing multiline textfields mirror their value into a hidden sizer.

sp-theme emits its theme fragment styles from static registerThemeFragment data (adoptedStyleSheets in the browser) and needs a dedicated renderer on the server. This entry also registers the light, dark, medium and large fragments used by the page shell.
Images are inline data: URIs; the slotted img is moved into the default slot of the thumbnail.
Closed on purpose: an open toast with a timeout would start a timer on connect. The icon and variant are rendered in the shadow root even while closed.
No tooltip is open. A self-managed tooltip finds its trigger via parentElement/parentNode at connect time and wires hover/focus listeners in the browser only.

Which item is selected is decided in the browser: sp-top-nav compares the resolved anchor href of each item (set in updated()) with its selected property or window.location.href, and clears any selected attribute on the items on the first slotchange. The selection indicator position is also measured (getBoundingClientRect), so none of it is known on the server and no item is marked selected here.
Trays are never opened here. sp-tray is a bottom-anchored modal; rendered closed it contributes only its (hidden) shadow DOM.

Whether the text overflows is only known after layout (offsetWidth vs clientWidth, re-checked by a ResizeObserver), so the overflow state and its tooltip are decided in the browser. The server output is the plain text with the tooltip closed.
